system.notes:
Fungibolds are deep-dwelling kobolds who have become one with the cave mushrooms, forming a hive mind. Their magi leaders become anchored to the earth as they merge with the vast network of underground fungi roots. Tiny body. Big hat. This kobold bears a weighty, peaked mushroom cap on its head; the fungi’s roots merge seamlessly into its neck.

AC 11, HP 6, ATK 1 sling (far) +1 (1d4) or 1 claw +1 (1d4) or 1 spore blast, MV near, S -2, D +1, C +2, I +1, W +0, Ch -1, AL N, LV 1

Hive Mind. Can telepathically speak with other fungibolds within a mile.

Spore Blast. Enemies in near DC 12 CON or fall asleep 1d4 rounds. Creatures who pass immune 1 day.

Art by Jessee Egan, 2023
